answer: The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in terrace, expire in lotus, and grove lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 182 aliases therefore needs 123 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 179 dollars in locked collateral and another 1 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
